purpose: Add a same-data legacy-V1 architecture arm, freeze a two-stage strength comparison, and make a valid win over the registered best legacy network a hard prerequisite for any release.

pipeline_override.action: Proceed directly with authenticated download of only DATAGEN 413 and 414, materialization, and production admission. Leave workload 416 and every foreign process untouched.

architecture_experiment.question: Under the same authenticated A0 records, targets, score scale, sample-order rule, update budget and engine binary, does NNUE V2 outperform the legacy-V1 architecture?

arms.initialization: fresh deterministic initialization for each paired seed
fresh deterministic initialization for each paired seed

legacy_training_gap.existing_tool_purpose: authenticated conversion of the registered historical legacy network only
required_before_legacy_training: a production legacy-V1 QAT trainer bound to the admitted A0 row format
a strict legacy .nnue exporter accepted by the current engine loader
checkpoint authentication and exact resume semantics
fresh-process reload and scalar/incremental parity evidence
negative tests proving that V2 features, canaries and historical artifacts cannot enter the A0 legacy arm

same_binary_rule.binary: one exact fresh Crazyhouse-Stockfish binary built after both trained-artifact routes are supported

strength_sequence.purpose: isolate the architecture effect under the same small A0 dataset and training budget
strength_sequence.advance_condition: V2 obtains a valid preregistered statistical win

strength_sequence.candidate: the unchanged A0_V2_LARGE seed-index-0 artifact from stage 1
strength_sequence.purpose: test whether the new network is actually stronger than the best registered legacy network despite the approximately 1M versus multi-billion-record data disadvantage
strength_sequence.release_authority: only a valid win at this stage may satisfy the network-strength release prerequisite

release_gate.if_stage_1_fails: retain evidence and continue data, recipe or architecture research without release
release_gate.if_stage_2_fails: retain evidence and continue scaling or ablation work without release

stopping_rules: Any DATAGEN 413 or 414 manifest, chunk, receipt, CAS, role, count, hash or publication-contract mismatch stops fail-closed without substitution or retry under changed evidence.
Any cross-role raw-record, position, trajectory or large-model-input intersection stops before training.

Any legacy trainer shortcut, historical-network substitution, feature-route mismatch, fallback, seed replacement, nonfinite metric, export rejection, reload failure or parity mismatch rejects the affected architecture arm.
Both architecture arms must complete all three paired seeds before stage 1 may start.
No loss value may change the predesignated playing artifact or strength sequence.
No release or candidate release is authorized until the unchanged stage-1 V2 artifact obtains a valid stage-2 win over the registered best legacy network in the same exact binary.
